translations.literal: The Zhedong bandit chief Qiu Fu took Xiangshan; government troops were repeatedly defeated, Ming Prefecture's gates were shut by day, and he advanced on Shan County with a force of a hundred men—the whole east of Zhe was alarmed.
translations.idiomatic: Bandit Qiu Fu seized Xiangshan and alarmed eastern Zhe.

sentences.zh: 觀察使鄭祗德遣討擊副使劉勍、副將范居植將兵三百，合台州軍共討之。

translations.literal: Observation commissioner Zheng Zhude sent punitive vice commissioner Liu Xin and deputy general Fan Juzhi with three hundred troops, joining Taizhou forces to attack him.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Zhude sent Liu Xin and Fan Juzhi with three hundred men.

sentences.zh: 司空、門下侍郎、同平章事令狐綯執政歲久，忌勝己者，中外側目，其子滈頗招權受賄。

translations.literal: Minister of Works, Vice Director of the Gate Bureau, and Co-Equal Chief Minister Linghu Tao had held power many years, envied those who surpassed him, and drew sidelong glances within and without; his son Hao widely traded on power and accepted bribes.
translations.idiomatic: Long in power, Linghu Tao envied rivals; his son Hao sold offices.

sentences.zh: 宣宗既崩，言事者競攻其短。

translations.literal: After Emperor Xuānzong died, remonstrators competed to attack his faults.
translations.idiomatic: After Xuānzong's death, critics assailed Tao.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以綯同平章事，充河中節度使。

translations.literal: On dingyou Tao was made Co-Equal Chief Minister and military commissioner of Hezhong.
translations.idiomatic: Dingyou: Linghu Tao was sent to Hezhong.

sentences.zh: 以前荊南節度使、同平章事白敏中守司徒、兼門下侍郎、同平章事。

translations.literal: Former Jingnan military commissioner and Co-Equal Chief Minister Bai Minzhong was made Defender of the Excellency, and concurrently Vice Director of the Gate Bureau and Co-Equal Chief Minister.
translations.idiomatic: Bai Minzhong became defender of the excellency and chief minister again.

sentences.zh: 初，韋皋在西川，開青溪道以通群蠻，使由蜀入貢。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Wei Gao was in Xichuan, he opened the Qingxi road to reach the various Man and had them enter by Shu to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Wei Gao had opened the Qingxi road for Man tribute through Shu.

sentences.zh: 又選群蠻子弟聚之成都，教以書數，欲以慰悅羈縻之。

translations.literal: He also selected sons and younger brothers of the various barbarian groups to gather them at Chengdu and teach them writing and reckoning, wishing thereby to comfort and please those held by loose reins.
translations.idiomatic: He also gathered sons of frontier tribes at Chengdu to teach literacy and arithmetic, hoping to win over those under loose suzerainty.

sentences.zh: 業成則去，復以他子弟繼之。

translations.literal: When their studies were finished they departed, and other sons and younger brothers were brought in to succeed them.
translations.idiomatic: When they finished their studies they left, and fresh recruits took their places.

sentences.zh: 如是五十年，群蠻子弟學於成都者殆以千數，軍府頗厭於稟給。

translations.literal: Thus for fifty years the sons of the various barbarian groups studying at Chengdu came to nearly a thousand; the military headquarters grew quite weary of supplying their rations.
translations.idiomatic: For fifty years nearly a thousand tribal students passed through Chengdu, and the command grew weary of feeding them.

sentences.zh: 又，蠻使入貢，利於賜與，所從傔人浸多，杜悰為西川節度使，奏請節減其數，詔從之。

translations.literal: Moreover, when barbarian envoys came to offer tribute they profited from imperial gifts, and the attendants who followed them gradually increased; Du Cong, military commissioner of Xichuan, memorialized requesting that their number be reduced, and an edict followed this.
translations.idiomatic: Tribute missions from the south grew their retinues to maximize gifts; Du Cong of Xichuan asked to cap their numbers, and the court agreed.

sentences.zh: 南詔豐祐怒，其賀冬使者留表付巂州而還。

translations.literal: Nanzhao's Fengyou was angry; his Winter Congratulations envoy left the memorial at Xizhou and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Fengyou of Nanzhao was furious; his winter-greeting envoy dropped the memorial at Xizhou and went home.

sentences.zh: 又索習學子弟，移牒不遜，自是入貢不時，頗擾邊境。

translations.literal: He again demanded the students under instruction; his dispatch was insolent; from this time tribute was not offered on schedule, and the borderlands were considerably disturbed.
translations.idiomatic: He again demanded the Chengdu students in insulting terms; tribute became irregular and the frontier grew troubled.

sentences.zh: 會宣宗崩，遣中使告哀，時南詔豐祐適卒，子酋龍立，怒曰：「我國亦有喪，朝廷不弔祭。

translations.literal: It happened that Emperor Xuānzong died and palace envoys were sent to announce the mourning; at the time Nanzhao's Fengyou had just died and his son Qulong had been established; he said angrily, "Our state also has a bereavement, yet the court does not offer condolences and sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: When Xuānzong died, Tang envoys announced the mourning just as Fengyou of Nanzhao died and his son Qulong succeeded; Qulong raged: "We too are in mourning, yet the court sends no condolences.

sentences.zh: 又詔書乃賜故王。」

translations.literal: Moreover, the edict was addressed to the deceased king."
translations.idiomatic: And your edict was addressed to our late king."

sentences.zh: 遂置使者於外館，禮遇甚薄。

translations.literal: He thereupon lodged the envoys in the outer guesthouse and treated them very meagerly.
translations.idiomatic: He housed the envoys in an outer lodge with scant courtesy.

sentences.zh: 使者還，具以狀聞。

translations.literal: When the envoys returned, they reported the full circumstances.
translations.idiomatic: The envoys returned and reported everything.

sentences.zh: 上以酋龍不遣使來告喪，又名近玄宗諱，遂不行冊禮。

translations.literal: The emperor, because Qulong had not sent envoys to announce the bereavement and because his name was near the taboo of Emperor Xuanzong, therefore did not carry out the investiture rites.
translations.idiomatic: Because Qulong had not announced his father's death and his name skirted Xuanzong's taboo, the emperor withheld investiture.

sentences.zh: 酋龍乃自稱皇帝，國號大禮，改元建極，遣兵陷播州。

translations.literal: Qulong thereupon styled himself emperor, named his state Great Li, changed the era name to Jianji, and sent troops to seize Bo Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Qulong declared himself emperor of Great Li, adopted the era Jianji, and seized Bo Prefecture by force.
